description: PCB, gerber for PCB fabrication, just upload this zip file to jlcpcb.com and order your PCB. Or buy a ready-made PCB.
Wemos D1 MINI V4.0 (any other version of WeMos that shares the output pins should work)
Mini DC-DC 12-24V To 5V 3A Step Down
A4988 stepper motor driver+heat sink (It is quite easy to burn it, especially if you are a beginner, better 2 units)
IRLZ44N MOSFET
capacitor 16V 100uf
pin header Male and Female
Terminal Block Connector 2P
10K ohms resistors R2
2K ohms resistors for R1 if firmware version >=1.4
Power Supply 12v 5A
Mini Micro Limit Switch Roller Lever Arm
Nema 17 stepper motor height >=38mm D shaped shaft (17HS4401S-Dupont)
Hotend MK8 12V 40W
Wire 2P 30AWG (for limit switch strip sensor, digital signal, I use the very thin wires stripped from an old LPT1 printer cable)
Wire 2P 18AWG (I use 25cm from the hotend heater cable)
10A 250V Male Power Socket 3 Pin IEC320 switch + Fuse
